description: Fundamentals of programming using Python: variables, control flow, functions, basic data structures, and problem solving.
Core data structures (lists, trees, graphs, hash tables) and algorithm design, complexity analysis, and efficiency.
Relational database design, SQL, normalization, transactions, and an introduction to NoSQL data models.
Supervised and unsupervised learning, model evaluation, neural networks, and practical machine learning workflows.
Network architecture, TCP/IP, routing, network security fundamentals, and distributed systems basics.
Team-based software development lifecycle: requirements, design, agile methodology, testing, and deployment.
Full-stack web development including frontend frameworks, backend APIs, and database integration.
